subject: Bridge letter request to cover post-report period for SOC 2 (Halcyon Systems)
messages:
From: Lina Morales <lina.morales@halcyon-systems.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover SOC 2 post-report gap (report end 2025-12-31)

Hi Dylan,

We're in the late stages of procurement for Halcyon Systems and the security team flagged that Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period through 2025-12-31. Our contract start date will be 2026-07-15, and our compliance team requires a bridge letter (or interim attestation) that affirms control continuity between 2026-01-01 and 2026-07-15.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a signed bridge letter covering that post-report period? Specifically, our security questionnaire needs:
- A bridge letter that (a) references the original report date and auditor, (b) confirms there have been no material changes to the control environment since the report end date, and (c) identifies which control categories are in scope.
- A copy of the SOC 2 Type II report you rely on (PDF) and the auditor contact for verification.
- Any interim evidence you can share (e.g., external penetration test summary, remediation timeline for any open findings, or control reaffirmation statement).

We aim to finalize procurement approvals by 2026-07-10. Is a bridge letter deliverable before then? Also please confirm whether the bridge letter can be signed by an authorized Redwood executive and provided as a PDF.

Thanks,
Lina Morales
Senior Security Analyst | Halcyon Systems
Lina.Morales@halcyon-systems.com

--
Halcyon Systems (Procurement contact: procurement@halcyon-systems.com)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lina Morales <lina.morales@halcyon-systems.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover SOC 2 post-report gap (report end 2025-12-31)

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear note and timeline.

We can provide a signed bridge letter that references our SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2025-12-31) and confirms continuity of controls for the requested period. A few quick clarifying items so we prepare the correct scope:
1) Scope: do you need coverage limited to production systems only, or do you require non-production environments (staging/dev) included?
2) Data types: is PII/PHI in scope for Halcyon's evaluation (this affects what we call out in the letter)?
3) Delivery: do you need a DocuSign flow or a signed PDF attached to email?

If possible please confirm these by EOD today. Assuming standard production-only scope, I can route the draft to our compliance lead (cc'd: Neha Kapoor) and expect a finalized, signed PDF within 3–5 business days. We will include the SOC 2 PDF and a short evidence summary.

Cc'ing Neha to coordinate the draft and sign-off.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: None

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-01T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Draft bridge letter + artifacts list for Halcyon (for review)

Dylan / team —

I've prepared a draft bridge letter for Halcyon and an artifacts checklist we usually provide for procurement. Key points in the draft:
- Reference: SOC 2 Type II report issued by Ashford & Co., report period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31.
- Statement: No material changes to the control environment affecting the Trust Services Criteria (Security, Availability) since the report end date through the requested coverage period (2026-01-01 to 2026-07-15).
- Scope: production systems only (default). If Halcyon needs non-prod included, we should confirm and add explicit language.

Artifacts to attach when sending externally:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20251231.pdf (redacted as needed)
- External pen test summary (Q1 2026) – summary PDF
- Bridge letter (signed PDF) — Redwood_bridge_halcyon_20260701.pdf

I recommend we send the draft to Lina noting the production-only assumption and ask for confirmation. Once they confirm scope we will finalize the signature (CEO or Head of Security authorized). If they require DocuSign, we can route it that way.

Draft is attached here for internal review. Please let me know edits.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Best regards,
